# Simplify

Combines splats to reduce their count while preserving the scene's overall appearance.

`lfs.simplify` · Clean-up

## How to use

Start with Ratio 0.5 to aim for half the splats.  
This can take longer than other nodes; lower ratios lose fine detail.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Ratio | `Ratio` | lfs.float | 0.5 | min 0.01; max 1; step 0.01 | Target share of splats to retain, 0.01–1. 0.5, the default, aims for half; 1 keeps the original count. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |
